words.gloss: having helpful allies or pleasant companionship

literal: Purity, companionship, courage-possession, of these three, truthfulness, is the quality of him who delivers the message in the proper way.
translation: Purity of character, influential allies, and courage—the genuine possession of these three qualities defines an envoy who delivers a message.
modern: தூய்மையான ஒழுக்கம், நல்ல துணை, துணிவு ஆகிய இம்மூன்றையும் உண்மையாகப் பெற்றிருப்பதே தூது உரைப்பவரின் தகுதியாகும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the three indispensable qualities of a successful envoy. First is 'தூய்மை' (purity), which denotes flawless integrity and moral uprightness, ensuring the envoy cannot be corrupted. Second is 'துணைமை' (companionship), which refers to having powerful allies or the tact to win over others. Third is 'துணிவுடைமை' (possession of courage), which allows the envoy to deliver difficult messages fearlessly in a foreign court. The genuine ('வாய்மை') presence of these three attributes constitutes the true character of one who speaks on behalf of a ruler.
